information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostic archive captured immediately after the tray icon and modules disappear overnight.

comment.body:
Thank you for the attached report and for clarifying that the latest disappearance occurred overnight 2026-08-25/26, not on the older dates highlighted by automated triage. The next occurrence needs evidence from that same failure window. Please provide:
- A comment containing `/bugreport` before restarting PowerToys; if the tray/settings UI is unavailable, run `BugReportTool.exe` from the PowerToys installation folder.
- Any Event Viewer **Windows Logs → Application** entries at the disappearance time for PowerToys processes, including the faulting module and exception code.
This will determine whether the runner crashed, was terminated during a session/power transition, or only failed its scheduled-task check.

title: PowerToys often absent from system tray first thing in the morning
